description: Source code for the implementation of 2D negative log likelihood loss functions in PyTorch's ATen library, including forward and backward passes with support for different reduction modes and optional weights.

methods.name: optional_contiguous
methods.description: Returns a contiguous tensor if the source tensor is defined, otherwise returns the source tensor unmodified.

methods.name: optional_data
methods.description: Returns the data pointer of the tensor or nullptr if undefined, with const correctness based on template parameter.

methods.name: check_inputs_nll_loss2d
methods.description: Checks the dimensions and sizes of input, target, and weight tensors for the NLL loss 2D forward pass.

methods.name: check_gradout_shape_nll_loss2d
methods.description: Checks the shape of grad_output tensor matches target tensor for backward pass.

methods.name: nll_loss2d_forward_out_frame
methods.description: Performs the forward pass of NLL loss 2D for a batch, supporting different reduction modes.

methods.name: nll_loss2d_forward_out_cpu_template
methods.description: Dispatches the forward computation to the appropriate scalar type.

methods.name: nll_loss2d_backward_out_frame
methods.description: Performs the backward pass of NLL loss 2D for a batch, supporting different reduction modes.

methods.name: nll_loss2d_backward_out_cpu_template
methods.description: Dispatches the backward computation to the appropriate scalar type.

methods.name: nll_loss2d_forward_out_cpu
methods.description: Wrapper for the forward pass that outputs tensors.

methods.name: nll_loss2d_forward_cpu
methods.description: Performs the forward pass and returns output and total weight tensors.

methods.name: nll_loss2d_backward_out_cpu
methods.description: Wrapper for the backward pass that outputs the gradient tensor.

methods.name: nll_loss2d_backward_cpu
methods.description: Performs the backward pass and returns the gradient tensor.

methods.name: nll_loss2d_out
methods.description: Computes the forward pass and outputs the result into provided tensor.

methods.name: nll_loss2d_symint
methods.description: Forward pass with symbolic integer ignore_index.
